name: animated-list
title: Animated List
description: A list that animates each item in sequence with a delay. Used to showcase notifications or events on your landing page.

props.name: children
props.description: The items, in order. They appear one at a time, newest on top. Give each a stable `key` so it animates in exactly once.

props.name: children
props.description: Item content. Used internally by `AnimatedList`; exported so you can reuse the pop-in animation.
